en.title: IGN Reveals Top 3 Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusives Worth Your Time
en.summary: IGN has curated a list of Nintendo Switch 2 exclusives that have earned a score of 8 or higher, showcasing the console's early gaming triumphs. From groundbreaking platforming to expansive adventures, these are the must-play titles for any Switch 2 owner.
en.body:
The Nintendo Switch 2 has only been gracing our living rooms for a little over a year, but it's already a powerhouse of critically acclaimed games. IGN has distilled the experience down to its absolute best, highlighting the Nintendo exclusives that have scored an impressive 8 or above in their reviews. This curated list serves as a definitive guide for anyone looking to dive into the cream of the crop on Nintendo's latest hardware.

The selection emphasizes Nintendo's commitment to its flagship franchises, delivering experiences that push the boundaries of what we expect from the platform. Leading the charge is **Donkey Kong Bananza**, a title that IGN hails as a "brilliant successor" and a "smashing return for a classic Nintendo character." The decision to center the Switch 2's inaugural 3D platformer around Donkey Kong, rather than the perennial Mario, has paid off handsomely, offering "satisfying, expressive movement and powerful, dynamic abilities" that forge a "truly groundbreaking adventure."

Following closely is **The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Switch 2 Edition**. This isn't just a port; it's an enhanced experience. IGN's review update suggests that the game "still hold[s] up as a game I can’t wait to lose a few dozen more hours in," with the Switch 2 additions making it feel "like this is the way it was always meant to be played." This testament to its enduring quality and the thoughtful enhancements solidifies its place as a must-have.

Rounding out the top-tier exclusives is **The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Switch 2 Edition**. For years, this title stood as the undisputed champion of the original Switch, and its transition to the new console continues to impress. Its inclusion signifies the Switch 2's ability to not only host new masterpieces but also elevate beloved classics to new heights, ensuring that legendary adventures remain accessible and vibrant for a new generation of players.

## What These Picks Mean for Fans

For dedicated Nintendo fans, this list represents a powerful validation of the Switch 2's early trajectory. It signals that Nintendo is not only delivering on its promise of high-quality first-party content but is also refining and re-releasing its most cherished titles with care. The focus on exclusives means players can be confident they are experiencing games designed specifically for the hardware, offering unique gameplay possibilities and pushing the console's capabilities. The community is buzzing with anticipation for these titles, seeing them as definitive reasons to invest in the new platform and a strong indicator of future releases.

## What's Next

While IGN's list focuses on current and recently enhanced titles, the promise of more Nintendo exclusives looms large. With **Donkey Kong Bananza** slated for a July 17, 2025 release, and **The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom** already available in its enhanced Switch 2 form, fans have concrete dates to look forward to. The inclusion of **Breath of the Wild** also hints at Nintendo's strategy of bringing its most iconic games to the new console, suggesting that more beloved titles could receive similar treatment.

These are predominantly first-party games published by Nintendo for either just the Switch 2 or both Switch consoles.
